messages.content: Monthly churn rose from 3% to 5% after a redesign. Our three candidate main causes are export discoverability, a price increase, and measurement change. Export tickets doubled. Churn rose equally on unchanged-price plans. The dashboard query is unchanged but tracking instrumentation has not been audited. These are supplied observations, not independently verified. Which operation would help now?
ACH would help compare how those observations bear on the three explanations, while retaining the tracking uncertainty. Would you like to try it?
